title.en: Find the Brightness of the Orange Pixel

brief.zh: 先用坐标找到橙色格，再用三个通道的加权结果读亮度。
brief.en: Use coordinates to find the orange tile, then read the brightness computed from the weighted channels.

concept.zh: 灰度会综合三个通道。它跟单独取红、绿、蓝任意一个读数不同。
concept.en: A grayscale value combines all three channels and can differ from every individual channel.

hints.zh: 从 (2, 0) 向右两格是 x = 4，再往下一格是 y = 1。
hints.en: Two tiles right from (2, 0) gives x = 4. One tile down gives y = 1.

label.en: Move coordinates and convert to grayscale

prompt.zh: 从 (2, 0) 向右两格、向下一格，读取最后到达的橙色像素的灰度。
prompt.en: Move two tiles right and one down from (2, 0). Read the grayscale value of the orange pixel you reach.
